subject.title: Bug: License incorrectly displayed as MIT-0 instead of MIT

question: Should ClawHub support declared MIT licenses for published skills whose package or LICENSE metadata says MIT, or keep the fixed MIT-0/no-attribution policy?
rationale: Current main, docs, and prior maintainer discussion encode fixed MIT-0, while the reporter and linked PR ask ClawHub to preserve declared MIT; automation cannot choose that legal/product contract.

options.title: Reaffirm fixed MIT-0 policy
options.body: Keep the existing platform-wide MIT-0 model and resolve this through documentation, publisher consent, or package remediation rather than mixed stored licenses.

options.title: Approve declared MIT support
options.body: Continue reviewing https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub/pull/2964 and require consistent schema, API, CLI, UI, docs, migration/backfill, and real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Pause for legal review
options.body: Leave this issue and the linked PR open until maintainers decide the license contract and obligations for already-published versions.

recommendation.title: Reaffirm fixed MIT-0 policy
recommendation.body: Keep the existing platform-wide MIT-0 model and resolve this through documentation, publisher consent, or package remediation rather than mixed stored licenses.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the MIT-0 enforcement commit and posted the prior product-direction comment choosing fixed MIT-0 licensing.
